Top 10 Charts to Watch | March 2026 Breakouts & Inflection Points
StockCharts TV
142000 subscribers
165 likes
9699 views
2 Mar 2026
David Keller shares his top 10 charts to watch for March 2026, breaking them into three key groups: stocks sustaining breakouts, Magnificent Seven names at crucial inflection points, and beaten-down charts potentially starting to turn. From energy strength and retail earnings to coil patterns and bottom-fishing setups, these charts highlight what could shape the month ahead.

Dave Keller walks through ten charts focused on breakout trends, major inflection points in the Magnificent Seven, and beaten-down stocks beginning to show early signs of accumulation. He explores energy strength, retail names heading into earnings, coil patterns and key support tests in mega-cap leaders, and potential bottoming setups showing improving momentum and volume. Along the way, Dave demonstrates how to use moving averages, RSI, volume indicators like Chaikin Money Flow, and the StockCharts Scan Engine to evaluate risk and identify emerging opportunities.
